checks.label: Local role scenarios · two reproducibility runs

cases.name: Two baskets, one unit
cases.description: Two queued baskets compete for one physical unit. Incoming supply cannot be sold early.

checks.label: Baskets reserved from the last unit
Inventory sees only its own run and store stock

cases.name: Delayed replenishment
cases.description: A shipment moves from minute 5 to minute 15. Inspect availability at the original ETA and receipt at the revised ETA.

checks.label: Physical units at the original ETA
Sellable units at the original ETA
Revised shipment ETA in simulated seconds
Available units after expiry and actual receipt

cases.name: Crash before acknowledgement
cases.description: A real worker process exits after writing stock but before committing. Its lease expires and another worker retries.

checks.label: Stock, basket and decision writes rolled back

cases.name: Cook from available pantry
cases.description: One household calls for pizza. A stocked kitchen should avoid unnecessary supermarket requests.

checks.label: No model or paid search reservations

cases.name: Source from another market
cases.description: The closest market has no flour. Queued sourcing forwards to the next market before cooking can start.

checks.label: Flour request visits market A then market B
All ingredient arrivals precede meal readiness
Facts replay into the same business state
Kitchen login denied raw stock table access

cases.name: Respect a declined replacement
cases.description: No market has beef. The household refuses chicken as a burger replacement; the kitchen must reject the order safely.

cases.name: Obtain replacement consent
cases.description: Beef is unavailable. A chicken replacement requires household consent followed by restaurant approval before cooking.

checks.label: Household and restaurant approvals precede cooking

cases.name: Competing dispatch workers
cases.description: Two real dispatcher workers claim different queued jobs concurrently while only one courier is online. The winner may vary.

checks.label: Jobs assigned to the available courier
Dispatcher login denied raw stock table access

cases.name: Traffic and judged retry
cases.description: Congestion doubles traversal time and two couriers drop out. Only a feasible approved retry should receive another courier.

checks.label: Every retry has a preceding approval
Every route uses the seeded traffic durations
No courier double booked at any checkpoint

cases.name: Accept only your own briefing
cases.description: A second courier tries to inspect and accept another courier assignment. Movement must wait for the assigned courier acknowledgement.

checks.label: Other courier briefing and acceptance denied
World motion waits for courier acknowledgement
Courier login denied raw stock table access

cases.name: Brief the replacement courier
cases.description: An approved retry carries the actual parcel checkpoint, prior courier and source events into its bounded handoff memory.

checks.label: Handoff parcel checkpoint matches the dropout
Replacement brief includes source events and approval
Arrivals fabricated for the abandoned order

cases.name: Finish only after physical arrival
cases.description: Couriers acknowledge their jobs and the trusted city advances them along roads. Delivery completion requires an arrival event.

checks.label: Every completed delivery has an arrival event
Route ETA equals the sum of edge durations

scenarios.note: Real scoped agents and durable queues; fixed local rules, no live model quality or latency claim. Scores are passed criteria / declared criteria; every criterion is required for a case to pass. Missing criteria receive no credit.

offline_judge.note: Rules oracle compared with itself; validates the harness, not model quality.
